title: Within You Without You
lyrics_synced:
[00:23.04] We were talking about the space between us all,
[00:34.00] and the people, who hide themselves behind
[00:43.09] a wall of illusion.
[00:48.55] Never glimpse the thruth, then it's far too late
[00:55.36] when they pass away!
[01:03.55] We were talking about the love we all could share.
[01:14.45] When we find it, to try our best to hold it there,
[01:25.36] with our love, with our love, we could save the world.
[01:32.64] If they only knew!
[01:43.55] Try to realise it's all within yourself,
[01:48.09] noone else can make you change.
[01:54.91] And to see you're really only very small
[01:59.91] and life flows on within you and without you!
[03:23.55] We were talking about the love that's gone so cold
[03:33.55] and the people who gain the world and loose their souls.
[03:44.45] They don't know,
[03:46.73] they can't see!
[03:49.89] Are you one of them?
[03:55.34] Are you one of them?
[04:07.64] When you've seen beyond yourself
[04:10.82] then you may find peace of mind is waiting
[04:18.55] there and time will come when you see we're
[04:22.64] all one and life flows on within you and
[04:27.18] without you!
